examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave udakarahado ubbhida-udako
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave udakarahado ubbhida-udako

16803.meaning1: with water welling up; with spring water
16803.commentary: (DNa) ubbhid'odako'ti ubbhinnaudako, na heṭṭhā ubbhijjitvā uggacchanakaudako. anto'y'eva pana ubbhijjanakaudako'ti attho

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, udakarahado ubbhid'odako. tassa n'ev'assa puratthimāya disāya udakassa āyamukhaṃ… devo ca na kālena kālaṃ sammādhāraṃ anuppaveccheyya.

16804.meaning2: breaks through (transitive); breaks through, bursts through (intrans.); springs up

examples.text: yadā mayaṃ jānāma kālaṅ'kato so puriso'ti, atha naṃ kumbhiṃ oropetvā ubbhinditvā mukhaṃ vivaritvā saṇikaṃ nillokema, app'eva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā'ti. n'ev'assa mayaṃ jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passāma.

16808.meaning1: with water which has sprung up

16809.meaning2: lifts up, raises one's under garment up

16810.meaning2: lifted up, raised one's under garment up

examples.text: appamādaṃ pasaṃsanti, puññakiriyāsu paṇḍitā, appamatto ubho atthe, adhiggaṇhāti paṇḍito.

16815.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ubha (+gen)
16815.meaning1: both; on both sides (of); in both ways; dually
16815.meaning2: in both ways or sides, twofold

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ubhato bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno, seyyathā'pi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ.
idha, bhikkhave, rañño bhaddo ass'ājānīyo ubhato sujāto hoti, mātito ca pitito ca. yassaṃ disāyaṃ aññe'pi bhaddā ass'ājānīyā jāyanti, tassaṃ disāyaṃ jāto hoti.

16816.meaning1: neither having lust; both being unaroused

16817.meaning1: both having lust; both being aroused
16817.commentary: (VINa) ubhatoavassute'ti ubhatoavassave, bhikkhuniyā c'eva purisassa ca kāyasaṃsaggarāgena avassutabhāve satī'ti attho.

16818.meaning2: carrying pole with a load at each end

16819.commentary: (ANt) ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhan'ti ubhohi koṭīhi yuttaṃ pañhaṃ. kiṃvādī bhavaṃ gotamo'ti hi puṭṭho kiriyavādimhī'ti vā vadeyya akiriyavādimhī'ti vā, tasmā imassa pañhassa vissajjane kiriyavādimhī'ti ekā koṭi, akiriyavādimhī'ti dutiyāti koṭidvayayutto ayaṃ pañho.

examples.text: imaṃ kho te, rājakumāra, samaṇo gotamo ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno n'eva sakkhiti uggilituṃ na sakkhiti ogilituṃ.

16821.meaning1: two-handled; double-handled; with handles on both sides

examples.text: ubhatodaṇḍakena ce'pi, bhikkhave, kakacena corā ocarakā aṅgam'aṅgāni okanteyyuṃ, tatrā'pi yo mano padūseyya, na me so tena sāsanakaro.

16822.meaning1: sharpened on both sides; double-edged; double-bladed

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
satthaṃ nāma ekatodhāraṃ ubhatodhāraṃ paharaṇaṃ.

16823.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of ubhatopakkha
16823.meaning1: in this double manner; in this dual way; in a double whammy
16823.commentary: (MNa) ubhatopakkhan'ti sukhaṃ ekaṃ pakkhaṃ dukkhaṃ ekaṃ pakkhan'ti evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ hutvā.

examples.text: yassa kassaci, aggivessana, evaṃ ubhatopakkhaṃ uppannā'pi sukhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā kāyassa, uppannā'pi dukkhā vedanā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati abhāvitattā cittassa, evaṃ kho, aggivessana, abhāvitakāyo ca hoti abhāvitacitto ca.

16825.meaning1: burnt at both ends; scorched on both sides
16825.commentary: (SNa) ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagatan'ti pamāṇena aṭṭh'aṅgulamattaṃ dvīsu ṭhānesu ādittaṃ majjhe gūthamakkhitaṃ. (VISMa) ubhatopadittan'ti ubhosu koṭīsu daḍḍhaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, chav'ālātaṃ ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ, n'eva gāme kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati, n'āraññe kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati.

16826.meaning1: with both (husband and wife) having faith
16826.commentary: (VINa) ubhatopasannan'ti dvīhi pasannaṃ upāsakena'pi upāsikāya'pi. tasmiṃ kira kule ubho'pi te sot'āpannāy'eva

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sāvatthiyaṃ aññataraṃ kulaṃ ubhatopasannaṃ hoti. saddhāya vaḍḍhati, bhogena hāyati, yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati purebhattaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā taṃ sabbaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vissajjetvā app'ekadā anasitā acchanti.

seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno, tassa ubhatopasse vadhakā uppateyyuṃ, tassa tatonidānaṃ chambhitattaṃ uppajjeyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, chambhitattaṃ udapādi, chambhitatt'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi. samādhimhi cute obhāso antaradhāyati dassanañ'ca rūpānaṃ.

16828.meaning1: hermaphrodite; with male and female sexual characteristics
16828.meaning2: having the sexual characteristics of both sexes; hermaphrodite
16828.commentary: (VINa) ubhatobyañjanā'ti itthinimittena ca purisanimittena cā'ti ubhohi byañjanehi samannāgatā.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.

16831.meaning1: on both sides; in both ways

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ.
ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto.

16832.meaning1: smoothed on both sides; softened on both sides
16832.commentary: (MNa) ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti maṇipāsāṇena ubhosu passesu suṭṭhu vimaṭṭhaṃ ghaṭṭetvā uppāditacchaviṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathā vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ.
upasaṅkamitvā rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi, icchām'ahaṃ, samma rattapāṇi, imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pīt'āvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rajitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan'ti.

16833.meaning1: liberated in both ways; emancipated in two regards; epithet of an arahant
16833.meaning2: liberated in both sides; emancipated in two ways
16833.commentary: (DNa) ubhatobhāgavimutto'ti dvīhi bhāgehi vimutto, arūpasamāpattiyā rūpakāyato vimutto, maggena nāmakāyato vimutto'ti.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, bhaddāli, idh'assa bhikkhu ubhatobhāgavimutto, tam'ahaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ, ehi me tvaṃ, bhikkhu, paṅke saṅkamo hohī'ti, api nu kho so saṅkameyya vā aññena vā kāyaṃ sannāmeyya, no'ti vā vadeyyā'ti?
katamo ca, bhikkhave, puggalo ubhatobhāgavimutto? idha ekacco puggalo ye te santā vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe āruppā te kāyena phusitvā viharati paññāya c'assa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.

16835.meaning1: liberation in both ways; freedom in both regards
16835.meaning2: liberation in both ways; freedom in both regards
16835.commentary: (DNa) imāya ca ānanda ubhatobhāgavimuttiyā'ti ānanda ito ubhatobhāgavimuttito.

examples.text: imāya ca ānanda ubhatobhāgavimuttiyā aññā ubhatobhāgavimutti uttaritarā vā paṇītatarā vā n'atthī'ti.

16837.meaning2: on both sides, in both respects

16838.meaning1: double-mouthed; with an opening at each end

examples.text: seyyathā'pi bhikkhave ubhatomukhā putoḷi pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa seyyath'idaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ
dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.

16839.meaning1: with red pillows on both sides; (comm) with red cushions for head and feet

examples.text: kodhano'yaṃ, bhikkhave, purisapuggalo kodh'ābhibhūto kodhapareto, kiñ'c'āpi so pallaṅke seti gonak'atthate paṭalik'atthate kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇe sauttaracchade ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāne, atha kho so dukkhaññ'eva seti kodh'ābhibhūto.
tatr'assa pallaṅko gonak'atthato paṭik'atthato paṭalik'atthato kadalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato-lohitak'ūpadhāno

16840.commentary: (VINa) ubhato saṅghe'ti bhikkhunisaṅghe ñatticatutthena bhikkhusaṅghe ñatticatutthenā'ti aṭṭhavācikavinayakammena upasampannā.

examples.text: bhikkhunī nāma ubhatosaṅghe upasampannā.

16842.meaning2: garland with a stalk on both sides

16843.meaning1: analysis of the monks' and nuns' training rules; first three books of the Vinaya Piṭaka

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo āyasmantaṃ upāliṃ catutthassa pārājikassa vatthum'pi pucchi, nidānam'pi pucchi, puggalam'pi pucchi, paññattim'pi pucchi, anupaññattim'pi pucchi, āpattim'pi pucchi, anāpattim'pi pucchi. eten'eva upāyena ubhatovibhaṅge pucchi. puṭṭho puṭṭho āyasmā upāli vissajjesi.

16844.meaning1: analysis of the monks' and nuns' training rules, chapters and accessories; books of the Vinaya Piṭaka
16844.construction:
ubhatovibhaṅga + niddesa + khandhaka + parivāra + ā
ubhatovibhaṅganiddesakhandhakaparivāra + ā
16844.commentary: (VINt) idāni sutt'ādīni nav'aṅgāni vibhajitvā dassento āha tattha ubhatovibhaṅga-niddesa-khandhaka-parivārā'ti-ādi.

examples.text: tattha ubhato-vibhaṅga-niddesa-khandhaka-parivārā suttanipāte maṅgalasutta-ratanasutta-nālakasutta-tuvaṭṭakasuttāni aññam'pi ca suttanāmakaṃ tathāgatavacanaṃ suttan'ti veditabbaṃ.

16845.meaning2: having the sexual characteristics of both sexes; hermaphrodite

16846.meaning2: having the sexual characteristics of both sexes; hermaphrodite

examples.text: so ubh'antam'abhiññāya, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so idha sibbinim'accagā'ti.
tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha tato tvaṃ bāhiya n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena
saddhāya sīlena ca yā'dha vaḍḍhati, paññāya cāgena sutena c'ūbhayaṃ, sā tādisī sīlavatī upāsikā, ādīyati sāram'idh'eva attano'ti.

16850.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of ubhaya
16850.meaning1: from both sides; in both ways
16850.meaning2: on both sides; in both ways

examples.text: atikkamma ca purisassa chavimaṃsalohitaṃ aṭṭhiṃ paccavekkhati. purisassa ca viññāṇasotaṃ pajānāti, ubhayato abbocchinnaṃ idha loke patiṭṭhitañ'ca paraloke patiṭṭhitañ'ca. ayaṃ tatiyā dassanasamāpatti.

16851.meaning1: in both cases; on both sides
16851.commentary: (ANa) ubhay'attha kaliggāho'ti ubhay'esam'pi diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikānaṃ atthānaṃ kaliggāho, parājayaggāho'ti attho. (DHPa) idam'assa paraloke vipākasocanaṃ. evaṃ so ubhay'attha socati'y'eva.

examples.text: idha socati pecca socati, pāpakārī ubhay'attha socati, so socati so vihaññati, disvā kammakiliṭṭham'attano.
sace kho atth'eva paro loko, evaṃ imassa bhoto purisapuggalassa ubhay'attha kaṭaggaho, yañ'ca diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ pāsaṃso, yañ'ca kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjissati.

16852.meaning1: benefit of both; welfare of both

examples.text: att'atthaṃ vā ñassati par'atthaṃ vā ñassati ubhay'atthaṃ vā ñassati uttariṃ vā manussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ sacchikarissatī'ti n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
ubhay'atthaṃ vā hi bhikkhave sampassamānena alam'eva appamādena sampādetun'ti

16854.meaning2: in both ways; in both cases

16856.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of ubhayantara

examples.text: yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda, dukkham'addakkhi sallato, ubhay'antarena n'āhosi, kena lokasmi kiṃ siyā.

16857.meaning1: hurting both; affliction of both; harm to both (self and other)

examples.text: yaṃ nu kho ahaṃ idaṃ kāyena kammaṃ kattu'kāmo idaṃ me kāyakammaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvatteyya
idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti.

16858.meaning2: between the two; within the two

16859.grammar: ind, adv, comp, instr sg of ubhayamantara

examples.text: yato tvaṃ, māluṅkyaputta, na tattha, tato tvaṃ, māluṅkyaputta, n'ev'idha, na huraṃ, na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

nissitassa calitaṃ, anissitassa calitaṃ n'atthi. calite asati passaddhi, passaddhiyā sati nati na hoti. natiyā asati āgatigati na hoti. āgatigatiyā asati cut'ūpapāto na hoti. cut'ūpapāte asati n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena. es'ev'anto dukkhassā'ti.

16860.meaning1: both of these; both of them

examples.text: ye ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmā, ye ca samparāyikā kāmā, yā ca diṭṭhadhammikā kāmasaññā, yā ca samparāyikā kāmasaññā, ubhayam'etaṃ māradheyyaṃ, mārass'esa visayo, mārass'esa nivāpo, mārass'esa gocaro.

ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, āvuso, vijjati yaṃ taṃ bhikkhuṃ bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ, āpattiṃ āpanno'ti. jānanti maṃ bhikkhū āpattiṃ āpanno'ti, iti so kupito hoti appatīto. yo c'eva kho, āvuso, kopo yo ca appaccayo, ubhayam'etaṃ aṅgaṇaṃ.

16862.meaning1: both mixed up; both mingled together; combined with both
16862.commentary: (DNa) ubhayavokiṇṇesu vattamānesū'ti ubhayesu vokiṇṇesu missībhūtesu hutvā vattamānesu. katamesu ubhayesū'ti? kaṇhasukkesu dhammesu viññugarahitesu c'eva viññuppasatthesu ca. (DNt) ubhayavokiṇṇe'ti vacanavipallāsena vuttan'ti āha ubhayesu vokiṇṇesū'ti.

examples.text: imesu kho, vāseṭṭha, catūsu vaṇṇesu evaṃ ubhayavokiṇṇesu vattamānesu kaṇhasukkesu dhammesu viññugarahitesu c'eva viññuppasatthesu ca yadettha brāhmaṇā evam'āhaṃsu

16863.meaning1: benefit of both; welfare of both

examples.text: idha, bhikkhu, paṇḍito mahāpañño n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti na parabyābādhāya ceteti na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti attahita-parahita-ubhayahita-sabbalokahitam'eva cintayamāno cinteti

16865.meaning1: both parts; both sides; both aspects

examples.text: evam'ass'āyaṃ apaṇṇako dhammo susamatto samādinno, ubhay'aṃsaṃ pharitvā tiṭṭhati, riñcati akusalaṃ ṭhānaṃ.

16866.meaning2: developed in both parts; practiced for both aspects or objects; (ubhayaṃsa)

examples.text: idha, mahāli, bhikkhuno puratthimāya disāya ubhay'aṃsabhāvito samādhi hoti dibbānañ'ca rūpānaṃ dassanāya piyarūpānaṃ kām'ūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ dibbānañ'ca saddānaṃ savanāya piyarūpānaṃ kām'ūpasaṃhitānaṃ rajanīyānaṃ.

16867.meaning1: in both directions; on both sides; in both ways
16867.meaning2: on both sides; in both ways
16867.commentary: (MNa) ubhayen'eva maṃ mātali nehī'ti mātali dvīhi maggehi maṃ nehi, ahaṃ nirayaṃ passitu'kāmo devalokam'pī'ti. paṭhamaṃ katamena nemīti. paṭhamaṃ nirayamaggena nehī'ti.

examples.text: api ca, mahārāja, katamena taṃ nemi, yena vā pāpakammā pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedenti, yena vā kalyāṇakammā kalyāṇakammānaṃ vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvedentī'ti? ubhayen'eva maṃ, mātali, nehī'ti.

16868.meaning1: benefit of both; good of both parties
16868.commentary: (JAa) ubhinnam'atthaṃ caratī'ti yo idha puggalo ete sīl'ādayo guṇe attani passati, so mayhaṃ ācārasīlam'pi atthi, paññā'pi sutapariyatti'pi atthī'ti tathato jānitvā gaṇaṃ pariharanto attano ca paresañ'ca attānaṃ parivāretvā carantānan'ti ubhinnam'pi attham'eva carati.

examples.text: ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca, paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
yo ca sīlañ'ca paññañ'ca, sutañ'c'attani passati, ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca.
ocarako nāma bhaṇḍaṃ ocaritvā ācikkhati, itthan'nāmaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharā'ti, āpatti dukkaṭassa. so taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ avaharati, āpatti ubhinnaṃ pārājikassa.
ubhinnam'atthaṃ carati, attano ca parassa ca, paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
ubhinnaṃ tikicchantānaṃ, attano ca parassa ca, janā maññanti bālo'ti, ye dhammassa akovidā'ti.
326, 341. ubhe tappurisā.
ubhe digukammadhārayasamāsā tappurisasaññā honti.

16872.grammar: pron, nom & acc pl of ubha

examples.text: tassa te nāga nāgassa, mahāvīrassa bhāsato, sabbe dev'ānumodanti, ubho nāradapabbatā.
mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici. iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.

16873.meaning1: both sides; both ends; both extremes

examples.text: yo ubho'nte viditvāna, majjhe mantā na lippati, taṃ brūmi mahāpuriso'ti, so'dha sibbinim'accagā'ti.
atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho'pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubho'pi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalam'pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
abhūtavādī nirayaṃ upeti, yo vā'pi katvā na karomi c'āha, ubho'pi te pecca samā bhavanti, nihīnakammā manujā parattha.

16875.meaning1: victory in both worlds; success here and hereafter

examples.text: yato kho, gahapatiputta, ariyasāvakassa cattāro kammakilesā pahīnā honti, catūhi ca ṭhānehi pāpakammaṃ na karoti, cha ca bhogānaṃ apāyamukhāni na sevati, so evaṃ cuddasa pāpak'āpagato chaddisāpaṭicchādī ubholokavijayāya paṭipanno hoti.
ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

tassā ubhosu tīresu kāsā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, kusā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, pabbajā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, bīraṇā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ, rukkhā ce'pi jātā assu, te naṃ ajjholambeyyuṃ.
ehi dāni, āvuso, ubho'va santā imaṃ gaṇaṃ pariharāmā'ti. iti kho, aggivessana, āḷāro kālāmo ācariyo me samāno attano antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapesi, uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesi.
sādhu vata maṃ āyasmanto imehi paccekacīvaracetāpannehi evarūpaṃ vā evarūpaṃ vā cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā acchādetha ubho'va santā ekenā'ti kalyāṇakamyataṃ upādāya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
ṭhitako kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo anonamanto ubhohi pāṇitalehi jaṇṇukāni parimasati parimajjati, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

16880.commentary: (JAa) umaṅgā'ti mahārāja, mayā attano māṇave pesetvā pāsādā otarāpetvā jaṅgha-umaṅgena āharāpetvā mahā-umaṅgā nīharitvā bandhavā te vedehassa upanāmitā'ti.

examples.text: etha māṇavā uṭṭhetha, mukhaṃ sodhetha sandhino, vedeho sahamaccehi, umaṅgena gamissati.
giriguhan'ti dvinnaṃ pabbatānaṃ antarā, ekasmiṃ'y'eva vā umaṅgasadisaṃ mahāvivaraṃ.
ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni. seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ
ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni. seyyathā'pi nāma umāpupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ

16885.commentary: (DNa) umāpupphadevā nāma ete devā. (DNt) umāpupphanibhāsino vaṇṇato umāpupphasadisā'ti evam'attho gahetabbo, aññathā ekādasa devakāyā siyuṃ.

examples.text: ath'āguṃ sahabhū devā, jalam'aggisikhā'r'iva, ariṭṭhakā ca rojā ca, umāpupphanibhāsino.

16886.meaning1: wrong way; side road; deviation; diversion
16886.commentary: (SNa) ummaggo'ti devalokaṃ vā manussalokaṃ vā nibbānaṃ vā gacchantassa amaggo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko, pehī'ti vutto, viddho samāno codito sārathinā ummaggaṃ gaṇhati, ubbaṭumaṃ rathaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco assakhaḷuṅko hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, catuttho assadoso.
evaṃ vutte, bhikkhave, upako ājīvako, hupeyya'p'āvuso'ti vatvā sīsaṃ okampetvā ummaggaṃ gahetvā pakkāmi.

16887.meaning1: coming up with question; emergence of an enquiry

examples.text: sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaggo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā
idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ sākacchāyamāno evaṃ jānāti, yathā kho imassa āyasmato ummaggo yathā ca abhinīhāro yathā ca pañhāsamudāhāro, duppañño ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā paññavā.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cakkhumā puriso udakarahadassa tīre ṭhito passeyya parittaṃ macchaṃ ummujjamānaṃ. tassa evam'assa, yathā kho imassa macchassa ummaggo yathā ca ūmighāto yathā ca vegāyitattaṃ, paritto ayaṃ maccho, n'āyaṃ maccho mahanto'ti.

16889.meaning1: wrong road; divergent path; deviant way
16889.commentary: (SNa) ummaggapathan'ti anekāni kiles'ummujjanasatāni, vaṭṭapathattā pana pathan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: ummaggapathaṃ mārassa abhibhuyya, carati pabhijja khilāni, taṃ passatha bandhapamuñcakaraṃ, asitaṃ bhāgaso pavibhajaṃ.

16890.meaningLit: discourse on coming up with question

16891.meaning1: good question; auspicious enquiry; (comm) wise investigation

examples.text: sādhu sādhu, bhikkhu! bhaddako kho te, bhikkhu, ummaṅgo, bhaddakaṃ paṭibhānaṃ, kalyāṇī paripucchā

16893.meaning2: emergence on the surface; (emergence of) an idea, conception; initial thought

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto upāliṃ gahapatiṃ etadavoca, ummatto'si tvaṃ, gahapati, datto'si tvaṃ, gahapati!
kiṃ ummatto'si, nanu idān'eva divākaro atthaṅ'gato, so kathaṃ imaṃ puṇṇacandaṃ anubandhamāno uggacchissati?

16895.commentary: (THa) ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasī'ti ummattakapurisena viya mayā saddhiṃ kīḷanto taṃ taṃ palobhanīyaṃ dassetvā palobhasi.

examples.text: nanu dubbhissasi maṃ punappunaṃ, muhuṃ muhuṃ cāraṇikaṃ'va dassayaṃ, ummattaken'eva mayā palobhasi, kiñ'c'āpi te citta virādhitaṃ mayā.
saññasaññino vuccanti ye pakatisaññāya ṭhitā, na'pi so pakatisaññāya ṭhito. visaññasaññino vuccanti ummattakā ye ca khittacittā, na'pi so ummattako, no'pi khittacitto'ti.
ruṇṇam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ. ummattakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ. komārakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakahasitaṃ.

16897.commentary: (VVt) ummattikāya vā'ti pittakopena ummādappattāya. idañ'ca asucī'ti vā candanan'ti vā visesataṃ ajānanam'eva pamāṇaṃ.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, brāhmaṇa, imissā'y'eva sāvatthiyā aññatarissā itthiyā mātā kālam'akāsi. sā tassā kālakiriyāya ummattikā khittacittā rathikāya rathikaṃ siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā evam'āha, api me mātaraṃ addassatha, api me mātaraṃ addassathā'ti?
